name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
short: Free observability and routing control plane over your own provider keys, with request logging, caching, rate limiting, fallback routing, and DLP/PII scanning on Cloudflare's edge.

plans.name: Free (core features)
plans.notes: Core features — request logging, caching, rate limiting, and fallback routing — are free on all plans with no markup when you bring your own provider keys. DLP and PII scanning available for prompt hygiene.

plans.name: Paid add-ons
plans.notes: Advanced analytics, higher log retention, and enterprise features billed on Cloudflare's paid tiers; tokens are billed by the underlying provider at list price.
